# OneGlanse

> Open-source AI visibility and GEO tracking from the answers shown on AI websites.

OneGlanse runs prompts on ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Google AI Overview. It saves answers and citations from the websites, then uses a separate model the user connects to score the saved text. It does not use the products' model APIs to fetch answers. Run it locally or on your own server.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://oneglanse.com/): What OneGlanse does and the AI products it supports.
- [How OneGlanse gets its data](https://oneglanse.com/methodology): Browser collection, analysis, and limits of a single run.
- [Why OneGlanse is self-hosted](https://oneglanse.com/why-self-hosted): The cost of operating browsers and proxies for many users.
- [Why OneGlanse uses Camoufox](https://oneglanse.com/why-camoufox): The browser change and its limits.
- [Full site content](https://oneglanse.com/llms-full.txt): Current long-form content generated from the landing pages and their shared content data.

## Compare

- [AI visibility tools](https://oneglanse.com/ai-visibility-tools): Product directory with public sources.
- [Open-source AI visibility tools](https://oneglanse.com/ai-visibility-tools/open-source): Products with published source code.
- [Self-hosted AI visibility tools](https://oneglanse.com/ai-visibility-tools/self-hosted): Products you can run on your own server.
- [Tools that use the real websites](https://oneglanse.com/ai-visibility-tools/browser-based): Products that collect at least some answers from AI websites.
- [All comparisons](https://oneglanse.com/compare): OneGlanse alongside other products.
- [OneGlanse vs Elmo](https://oneglanse.com/compare/oneglanse-vs-elmo): Open-source tools with different collection and reporting options.
- [OneGlanse vs Profound](https://oneglanse.com/compare/oneglanse-vs-profound): Self-hosted tracking and managed analytics.
- [OneGlanse vs Peec AI](https://oneglanse.com/compare/oneglanse-vs-peec-ai): Self-hosted tracking and agency reporting.
- [OneGlanse vs Otterly AI](https://oneglanse.com/compare/oneglanse-vs-otterly-ai): Self-hosted tracking and managed daily checks.
- [OneGlanse vs Promptwatch](https://oneglanse.com/compare/oneglanse-vs-promptwatch): Browser-based tracking and crawler analytics.
